scope: Exact native ground turret weapon/muzzle selection across existing fire paths.
finding: GroundFireReady identified loaded ammunition on a specific fullCrew turret path, but callers requested generic gunner selectWeapon and acknowledged currentMuzzle on the actor. This trace establishes an API/station ambiguity, not proof that every former selection failed in game.
implementation: GroundFireReady observations now include loadedTurret from the actual station alongside loadedWeapon/Muzzle/Magazine, reset on every call.

Shared CortexGroundSelectMuzzle requires actual local AI gunner, matching native crew turret and turretLocal. It requests selectWeaponTurret with weapon/path/muzzle only when selected station differs, then reads weaponState for the selected station.

Routine gunnery, ground danger suppression, immediate combined GROUND_FIRE and arrival-stage combined ground fire use the same selection acknowledgement. Existing ROE/target/lane/token and fresh-ammunition guards remain callers authority.

Unacknowledged native selection grants no doTarget/doFire/doSuppressiveFire; existing finite waits/next callback remain. No forced shot, reload modification, new timer or ammunition creation. Trusted server remote context remains accepted for existing combined fire dispatch.
cost: One <=64 crew-row validation, <=16 station weapon membership and at most two native selected-state reads per selection attempt. No world search/handler. Runtime overhead unmeasured.

validation.initialFocusedFailure: An old assertion still expected generic gunner selectWeapon; replaced with shared selector/native acknowledgement contract. Source coverage regenerated under existing GUNNERY case; no added test case or acceptance score.

remaining: Actual coax/main/secondary muzzle switching and Fired-event ammunition consumption.
